system_purpose: Make 5 years of Tech Lab call transcripts usable for fast retrieval of marketing intelligence: right-fit-client questions, content hooks, pain points, objections, content angles, and topic-based content packs.
current_status: Proof-of-concept for internal boss demo. Foundation pipeline, mock extraction, and topic pack workflow are built and validated. Extraction records are MOCK placeholders pending a real LLM extraction run.
search_scripts: scripts/query_local_kb.py — keyword search over raw chunks (SQLite FTS5)
topic_scripts: scripts/discover_topics.py — list topics the archive supports
scripts/build_topic_pack.py — full grouped pack for one topic
scripts/export_topic_assets.py — clean asset list for hand-off
natural_language_interface: app.py — Streamlit demo app (launch: streamlit run app.py; requires pip install streamlit)
scripts/natural_language_router.py — importable intent + closest-match topic router (also CLI: python3 scripts/natural_language_router.py "give me hooks")
do_not_modify: Raw transcript .txt files in the project root and raw_transcripts/
recommended_retrieval_order: 2. database/topic_packs/*.json — if a pack for the topic already exists
5. processed/cleaned_transcripts/ — only when broader context is needed
supported_user_requests: What topics can I make questions from?
Give me right-fit-client questions / hooks / objections / pain points for <topic>
Give me YouTube / short-form / email angles for <topic>
Export a clean list of <asset type> for <topic>
unsupported_or_deferred_requests: Semantic/vector search (deferred — keyword matching only today)
Speaker attribution (impossible — source has no speaker labels)
Timestamped citations (impossible — source has no reliable timestamps)
Real LLM extraction quality (deferred — current records are mock placeholders)
known_limitations: Topic matching is keyword/alias based, not semantic.
Extraction records are conservative mock placeholders (verbatim sentences routed by keyword signals, confidence 0.3).
Dates come from filenames; many are 'unknown'.
Transcripts contain transcription errors; quotes are faithful to the transcript, not necessarily to what was actually said.
mock_mode_warning: All records in database/extracted_marketing_insights.jsonl currently have extraction_provider='mock'. Treat questions/hooks/angles as placeholders for workflow testing.
